title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch Double Wall Mount With Gallery Rail, Solid Brass Hardware | Oil Rubbed Bronze | Waverly Place | Allied Brass
description:
Free up vanity space with a wall-mounted glass shelf that keeps everyday bathroom items organized and easy to reach in Oil Rubbed Bronze, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any bathroom. This double glass shelf (also called a bathroom wall shelf or floating shelf) adds storage while maintaining a clean, transitional look—ideal for matching Waverly Place and other transitional bathroom hardware.

Highlights:
- Oil Rubbed Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Coordinates with other Waverly Place pieces for a distinguished, heritage-inspired look
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Choose a coordinated style for transitional bath accessories in the Waverly Place collection
- Get a neat, finished install with concealed screw mounting hardware (wall mount / wall-mounted / wall hanging)

Specs & Installation:
- Glass dimensions (each shelf): 16 x 5 inches
- Overall size: 16 in length x 8 in height x 5 in projection
- Weight capacity: 4 lb
- Material: solid brass hardware (brass construction) with tempered glass shelves
- Mounting type: wall mount
- Assembly required: no
- Included: glass shelf set and all installation hardware; screw size #8 x 1 1/4"
multiple designer finish options available to complement grooved bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories
